_provenance: Captured live (2026-08-12) via a hook on HIDDevice.prototype.sendReport/sendFeatureReport (out) and the device's own inputreport event (in, a REAL ACK, not constructed via a byte[6] flip) while clicking "Clear GIF" (Equipment setup tab). Confirmed deterministic across 3 independent capture attempts this session (2 out-only, 1 full duplex including these real ACKs). Every checksum independently re-verified by hand against the outer checksum16 formula: cmd18's payload sums to 369 (0x0171), matching bytes 4-5 here; cmd19's sums to 547 (0x0223), also matching. This supersedes fields.json's older cmd18_gifSession anecdote ("Milestone 2's 'Clear GIF' capture sent both as 0x40, so those samples are a different sequence and not a cross-check for these") with the first decoded, checksummed, committed capture of this command.
captured: 2026-08-12, one click on "Clear GIF", Equipment setup tab. 8 raw HID events total for this one click: 2x [infoPackage-out, infoPackage-ACK-in, finish-out, finish-ACK-in] -- no repeat loop, unlike clear-picture's 16x. The two infoPackage halves carry DIFFERENT payloads (cmd18 then cmd19), not one payload repeated.

timing.note: Every gap is 0-7ms, ordinary HID round-trip time -- no deliberate vendor pause here, unlike picture-upload's 300ms start-to-declare-size sleep or GIF-upload's 30ms/3000ms host sleeps (see fields.json's own pictureUpload/gifUpload notes for those). build_clear_gif_sequence() therefore adds no artificial delay of its own; Device::send_sequence()'s existing per-report ACK-wait is the only pacing, the same as build_page_switch_sequence().
